content: Brazilian IR Bens e Direitos crypto rules: (1) Threshold is R,000 per individual asset TYPE (BTC, ETH, etc. counted separately). Below threshold for a given asset, no need to declare. (2) Report under Group 08 (Criptoativos) — code 01=BTC, 02=ETH, 03=Altcoins, 10=Stablecoins, 99=Others. (3) Declare acquisition cost in BRL (NOT market value). Value never updates due to price fluctuation. (4) Dec 31 year-end snapshot — report what you held and its original cost as of December 31 of prior year. (5) Discriminação field requires: asset name, quantity, custodian name, custodian CNPJ.
